scheme_name: Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must have secured admission to a professional or technical course in India or abroad
Unique Disability ID (UDID) registration is mandatory for loan amounts of ₹15 lakhs and above
Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID)
benefits_summary: Education loans up to ₹50 lakhs for persons with disabilities to pursue professional and technical education in India or abroad.
documents_required: Age certificate issued by a competent authority
Proof of Unique Disability ID (UDID) registration
